T: Two men enter. One snack leaves.
D: Max ends up in Bartertown and its fight to the death arena.
P: Serve the mains when the Thunderdome match begins.
S: Medjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and a toasted almond, dried figs halved, aged cheddar in shards and crackers, all laid out on a rough board like a market stall.
Pork rind scored, salted and dried overnight in the fridge, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes until it blisters and cracks.

Self-raising flour with a pinch of salt, butter rubbed in, milk mixed in with a knife until just combined, shaped into a round, scored, baked at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Butter and golden syrup.
M: Pork shoulder scored, salted overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes then 160C for 3 hours. Apple sauce and roast veg.
the boss of Bartertown eats well

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rosemary, rubbed with oil and salt, roasted at 180C until 58C in the thickest part, rested 20 minutes, sliced, with a fresh mint sauce of chopped mint, sugar, vinegar and boiling water.
W: Butter sponge cubes dipped in thin chocolate icing, rolled in desiccated coconut, jam and cream in the middle.
K: Ginger beer over ice with a squeeze of lime and a slice of fresh ginger.

s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and fill each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond. Halve 8 dried figs. Lay out on a rough board with shards of 200g aged cheddar and crackers.

Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and a pinch of salt. Mix in about 300ml milk with a knife until just combined. Shape into a round, score and bake at 200C for 30 minutes until hollow. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: the boss of Bartertown eats well
m.how: Stud a 2kg lamb leg with garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and salt, and roast at 180C until 58C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Mix chopped mint with sugar, 3 tbsp vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce.

w.how: Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour. Cut into squares, split and fill with jam. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g coconut. Pipe cream in the middle.

d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Add a thin slice of fresh ginger and a squeeze of lime to each, then top with 250ml ginger beer. Two drinks enter, two drinks leave.
